nom: Buttah Skin Brightentng Vitamin C Serum

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports no breakouts from the serum, describing a smooth, glowing result; another reports the product stings on micro-cracks caused by eczema-related dryness but is still tolerated even near the eyelids.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or eczema-prone skin report improved dryness, uneven color and moisture retention, though one notes stinging on cracked patches; another states the formula does not leave the dry, tight feeling other vitamin C serums caused.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s, 60s, 70s and 80s report brighter, more even-toned, glowing skin and, in a few cases, a visible softening of fine lines and wrinkles.
segments.oily: One reviewer reports smaller-looking pores and less oily skin alongside an improved glow.
segments.combination: One reviewer with adult acne and uneven texture reports fading of spots and a more even skin tone with continued use.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers (50s–80s) report a brighter, more even, glowing complexion, and a couple describe visibly reduced fine lines; no dissent on this concern was found.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe added moisture, moisturized/hydrated glow and improved dryness including for eczema-related dryness; one of these same reviewers notes the product can sting on very dry, cracked skin.
concerns.redness: Not enough reviewer detail on redness specifically to report a pattern.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with eczema-related dryness and micro-cracking reports stinging on application, though found the product otherwise gentle enough to use near the eyelids.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, sun-related discoloration and acne marks, some within one to two weeks; no reviewer reports spots worsening.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report reduced acne, cleared breakouts, or faded acne scars, including for teenage acne and adult acne; however, two reviewers state the reformulated serum caused new breakouts and made skin feel sticky, and one other reviewer describes initial breakouts before skin adjusted.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports smaller pores and less oily skin; no other reviewer discusses oil control specifically.

extraits.texte: Unfortunately, the ingredients have changed with the Vitamin C serum. With every use my face feels sticky and breaks out really bad. It smells like a hand full of coins to. I've stocked up on the kits and I can't use the Vitamin C serum anymore, so money wasted as far as the serum goes. It sucks because it never broke me out before the change.
I have sensitive skin and this product did not break me out. It gives my skin a nice glow and it feels really smooth.

A bit stinky but has help a lot with dry skin, uneven color, moisture retention and of course, daily use as directed for the last 3 months. Can sting a for a little bit if you have micro scratches/cracking from very dry skin like I do from eczema. Found it gentle enough to use around my eyelids too. Everyone's skin is different so take my word with a grain of salt.
This stuff is a game changer for my skin. My pores are smaller, my skin is less oily and i have an unbelievable glow.
I buy this for my teenage son. He loves the whole facial care products - the serum work really well for a teenage boy that plays football and constantly suffers from acne from equipment and sun.

Excellent product! I've tried other vitamin c serums that just broke my face out but this one is formulated gently and gives my skin softness and suppleness that I need! I've been using the product consistently for over a year and my skin looks great!

extraits.titre: Disappointed in new formula of the Vitamin C "serum"
extraits.texte: Ugh, these companies always fixing things that aren't broken. As a long-time loyal customer of ButtahSkin, I'm extremely disappointed by the recent change to the Vitamin C Serum formula. The previous version was far superior—thicker in texture, more effective on my skin, and provided a truly luxurious experience. Unfortunately, this new formula is a major letdown. Its watery consistency, almost like the Rosewater Toner, is nothing like the serum I once loved. This is not what I would expect from a high-quality product. To make matters worse, it no longer gives my skin that radiant glow it once did. I used to notice an instant brightness after using the old formula, but now my skin feels dull and lackluster.
